title: Filtering the suppliers table by numbers · part 3

steps.title: Keep id != 7
steps.prompt:
Numbers compare with small symbols:
  > bigger   < smaller   = exactly   != not equal
Keep the rows where id is not equal to 7.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM suppliers WHERE id != 7;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM suppliers.
Add WHERE after the table name.
The test is id != 7.
Write: SELECT id FROM suppliers WHERE id != 7;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM suppliers WHERE id != 7;
steps.memory_trick: WHERE keeps only the rows that pass the test.

steps.title: Count rows id != 7
steps.prompt: COUNT(*) counts how many rows survive the filter.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT count(*) FROM suppliers WHERE id != 7;
hints: Start with SELECT count(*).
FROM suppliers.
Add WHERE id != 7.
Write: SELECT count(*) FROM suppliers WHERE id != 7;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM suppliers WHERE id != 7;
